description: Updates an existing file in a GitLab repository. Commits the changes to the specified branch with the provided commit message. Use this action when you need to modify file contents, change file permissions, or update files in a specific branch. Note that if concurrent modifications occur (detected via last_commit_id), the update will fail.

author_email.description: The email address of the commit author.
author_email.title: Author Email

author_name.description: The name of the commit author.
author_name.title: Author Name

branch.description: Name of the branch to commit to. The commit is added to this branch.
branch.title: Branch

content.description: The new content of the file.
examples:
# New Content
This is the updated file content.
content.title: Content

encoding.description: Change encoding to base64. Default is text.
encoding.title: Encoding

execute_filemode.description: Enable or disable the execute flag on the file.
execute_filemode.title: Execute Filemode

file_path.description: URL-encoded full path to the file in the repository (e.g., lib%2Fclass%2Erb or path/to/file.txt).
file_path.title: File Path

id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.
id.title: Id

last_commit_id.description: Last known file commit ID. Used to detect concurrent modifications.
last_commit_id.title: Last Commit Id

start_branch.description: Name of the branch to start the new commit from. If not provided, defaults to the value of branch.
start_branch.title: Start Branch

name: update_repository_file

branch.description: The name of the branch where the file was updated.
branch.title: Branch

file_path.description: The path to the updated file.
file_path.title: File Path
